dataset.name: Metastatic clear-cell RCC (IMmotion150, 2018)
dataset.description: Independent randomized phase II renal-cell carcinoma cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA-seq and treatment-anchored progression-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Treatment-naive metastatic clear-cell or sarcomatoid-component renal-cell carcinoma randomized to atezolizumab, atezolizumab plus bevacizumab or sunitinib. This treatment-selected metastatic cohort remains separate from primary-tumor TCGA-KIRC and other renal cohorts.

metadata.study_design: Randomized phase II first-line metastatic RCC trial
metadata.treatment_context: Atezolizumab, atezolizumab plus bevacizumab, or sunitinib
metadata.histology_basis: Trial eligibility required metastatic clear-cell RCC or RCC with a sarcomatoid component; the DataHub sample code is the broader RCC label.
metadata.curation_note: All 263 source RNA-seq profiles are labelled pretreatment and map one-to-one to endpoint-complete patients. PFS analyses must remain within one randomized arm; pooled estimates across atezolizumab, atezolizumab plus bevacizumab and sunitinib are prohibited.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment metastatic clear-cell or sarcomatoid-component RCC biopsy

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise before log2(TPM + 1); different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub molecular-profile metadata identifies the frozen source values as TPM. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Disease progression or death as encoded by the source trial PFS status
